items.distractor_fact: ಪಕ್ಕದ ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ದಿನ ತಾಪಮಾನ {D}°C ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring city, the temperature that same day was {D}°C.
items.entity_note: a different city's temperature reading, not the one whose dawn/noon temperatures the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಷೇರು ಬೆಲೆ ಅದೇ ದಿನ €{D} ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: Another company's share price that same day was €{D}.
items.entity_note: a different company's share price, not the one whose opening/closing price the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಪಕ್ಕದ ಸರೋವರದ ನೀರಿನ ಮಟ್ಟ ಅದೇ ಸಂಜೆ {D} m ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring lake's water level that same evening was {D} m.
items.entity_note: a different lake, not the one whose before/after-rain levels the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಇದೇ ತಿಂಗಳು €{D} ಠೇವಣಿ ಮಾಡಲಾಯಿತು.
items.gloss_en: Into another savings account, €{D} was deposited this same month.
items.entity_note: a different savings account, not the one whose deposit/withdrawal the question compares

items.gloss_en: Another gift card had €{D} on it at the start.
items.entity_note: a different gift card, not the one whose starting amount/spending the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ಡೇಟಾ ಯೋಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇದೇ ತಿಂಗಳ ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ {D} GB ಇತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: Another data plan had {D} GB at the start of this same month.
items.entity_note: a different mobile data plan, not the one whose starting/used data the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಈ ತಿಂಗಳ ಆದಾಯ €{D} ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
items.gloss_en: Another household's income for this month was €{D}.
items.entity_note: a different household, not the one whose income/expenses the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ತಂಡ ಇದೇ ಋತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ {D} ಗೋಲ್ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
items.gloss_en: Another team scored {D} goals in this same season.
items.entity_note: a different football team, not the one whose scored/conceded goals the question compares

items.distractor_fact: ಬೇರೊಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಇದೇ ತ್ರೈಮಾಸಿಕದಲ್ಲಿ €{D} ಲಾಭ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿತು.
items.gloss_en: Another small business recorded €{D} in gains during this same quarter.
items.entity_note: a different small business, not the one whose gains/losses the question compares
